title: Guard against tracked coordination state and clean main
description: Add a doctor check (coordination:tracked-state) that hard-fails when any path under coordination/claims, coordination/queue, or coordination/handoffs is tracked by git on a normal branch (skipped when checked out on the coordination branch), using the existing git() and currentBranch() helpers. In the same change, verify the CLI never reads the repo-root coordination/ directory as a fallback (it operates on .appbuilder/coordination-worktree), then git rm the 13 stale tracked files and add coordination/claims/, coordination/queue/, coordination/handoffs/ to .gitignore alongside the existing coordination/generated/ entry. Combining the guard and the cleanup in one PR keeps main green on merge. Written test-first.
acceptance_criteria: doctor reports problem coordination:tracked-state (and lists it under failures) when a coordination/claims|queue|handoffs file is tracked on a normal branch, and ok otherwise.
A test creates a git fixture with a tracked coordination/claims file, asserts the failure, then untracks it and asserts the check clears.
After the change, on main, git ls-files coordination/claims coordination/queue coordination/handoffs returns nothing and appbuilder doctor passes.
